package app

// The job codec and job value tests (#168): testdata/golden/gen_jobs emitted, with this file
// beside it as zz_e2e_test.go. internal/gen's jobs_test.go runs it.

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"alder/rt"
	"alder/rt/std"
)

// everything is a Signup.Everything's parameters with every kind of field set.
func everything() Signup__Everything__Params {
	return Signup__Everything__Params{
		N:       -7,
		X:       1.5,
		Ok:      true,
		Title:   "a \"title\"",
		User:    "u1",
		Due:     rt.Just(rt.Date{Y: 2026, M: 11, D: 16}),
		At:      rt.Nothing[time.Time](),
		Tags:    []string{"x", "y"},
		Address: Signup__Address{Street: "Main", Zip: rt.Just(int64(12345))},
		Shape:   Signup__Shape__Rect__(payload__Signup__Shape__Rect{W: 1, H: 2}),
		Shapes:  []rt.Maybe[Signup__Shape]{rt.Just(Signup__Shape__Circle__(0.5)), rt.Nothing[Signup__Shape](), rt.Just(Signup__Shape__Dot__)},
		Tree: Signup__Tree__Node__(payload__Signup__Tree__Node{
			Left:  Signup__Tree__Leaf__,
			Value: 3,
			Right: Signup__Tree__Node__(payload__Signup__Tree__Node{Left: Signup__Tree__Leaf__, Value: 4, Right: Signup__Tree__Leaf__}),
		}),
		Outcome: rt.Err[string, int64]("nope"),
	}
}

func TestJobCodec_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	for _, p := range []Signup__Everything__Params{everything(), func() Signup__Everything__Params {
		p := everything() // the other way of each Maybe, and Ok
		p.Due, p.At = rt.Nothing[rt.Date](), rt.Just(time.UnixMilli(1763251200123).UTC())
		p.Address.Zip = rt.Nothing[int64]()
		p.Outcome = rt.Ok[string, int64](42)
		return p
	}()} {
		text := rt.JsonEncode(jobenc__Signup__Everything__Params(p))
		v, err := std.JobParse(text)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("JobParse(%s): %v", text, err)
		}
		got, err := jobdec__Signup__Everything__Params(v, "")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("decode %s: %v", text, err)
		}
		if !rt.Eq(got, p) {
			t.Errorf("round trip of %s:\ngot  %s\nwant %s", text, rt.Show(got), rt.Show(p))
		}
	}
	text := rt.JsonEncode(jobenc__Signup__Everything__Params(everything()))
	for _, want := range []string{
		`"user":"u1"`,  // a brand is its base
		`"at":null`,    // Nothing is null
		`"due":"2026-11-16"`,
		`"zip":12345`,  // Just is the value
		`"shape":{"tag":"Rect","args":[{"w":1,"h":2}]}`,
		`"shapes":[{"tag":"Circle","args":[0.5]},null,{"tag":"Dot","args":[]}]`,
		`"outcome":{"tag":"Err","args":["nope"]}`,
		`"address":{"street":"Main","zip":12345}`,
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(text, want) {
			t.Errorf("%s does not contain %s", text, want)
		}
	}
}

// A row whose parameters no longer decode (a field retyped or renamed since) is an error naming
// the field, through the codec and through Jobs()'s Run.
func TestJobCodec_Drift(t *testing.T) {
	var run func(string) error
	for _, k := range Jobs() {
		if k.Name == "Signup.SendWelcome" {
			run = func(params string) error { _, err := k.Run(nil, params); return err }
		}
	}
	if run == nil {
		t.Fatal("Jobs() has no Signup.SendWelcome")
	}
	for params, want := range map[string]string{
		`{"user": 3}`:                  "user: expected a Text, got an Int",
		`{}`:                           "user: missing",
		`{"usr": "u1"}`:                "user: missing",
		`[1]`:                          ": expected an object, got a list",
		`{"user": "u1"} x`:             "text after the JSON value",
	} {
		err := run(params)
		if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), want) {
			t.Errorf("Run(%s) = %v, want an error containing %q", params, err, want)
		}
	}
	if err := run(`{"user": "u1"}`); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("Run of good parameters: %v", err)
	}
	// a Maybe field renamed since the row was written: missing, not Nothing
	enc := rt.JsonEncode(jobenc__Signup__Everything__Params(everything()))
	for from, want := range map[string]string{`"at":`: "at: missing", `"zip":`: "address.zip: missing"} {
		v, _ := std.JobParse(strings.Replace(enc, from, `"renamed":`, 1))
		if _, err := jobdec__Signup__Everything__Params(v, ""); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), want) {
			t.Errorf("renamed Maybe field %s: %v, want %q", from, err, want)
		}
	}
	// nested: the path names the field inside the custom type
	v, _ := std.JobParse(strings.Replace(rt.JsonEncode(jobenc__Signup__Everything__Params(everything())), `"h":2`, `"h":"2"`, 1))
	if _, err := jobdec__Signup__Everything__Params(v, ""); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "shape.Rect.h: expected an Int") {
		t.Errorf("nested drift: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestJobValue_Eq(t *testing.T) {
	a, b := Signup__welcome("u1"), Signup__welcome("u1")
	if !rt.Eq(a, b) || rt.Eq(a, Signup__welcome("u2")) {
		t.Errorf("equal parameters give equal jobs: %v %v", a, b)
	}
	if a.Kind != "Signup.SendWelcome" || a.Params != `{"user":"u1"}` {
		t.Errorf("job value = %+v", a)
	}
	if s := rt.Show(a); !strings.Contains(s, "Signup.SendWelcome") || !strings.Contains(s, `\"user\":\"u1\"`) {
		t.Errorf("Show = %s, want the kind and the parameters", s)
	}
}
